normalizer.dictionary_scope: Initial mandatory groups for this proposed v1 seed; custom semantic aliases are explicit. No universal language stemming or automatic synonym inference.
normalizer.create_rule: Any group member as canonical input claims every group member atomically. Client and service recompute closure; omission is validation failure, not a bypass.
normalizer.upgrade: New immutable policy record; collision report and explicit resolution before adopting; never rewrite historical keys or silently change an existing version.

limits.unit: UTF-8 bytes after decompression; counts are elements, not bytes
limits.package_managed_blob_bytes: not-buffered; streamed with declared length and host storage-budget checks

bound_tests: For every finite limit construct valid input at max and max+1; reject +1 atomically. Also test equivalent character counts with multibyte UTF-8, decompression expansion, empty required names, leading-zero counters, sr1:0, sr1:9223372036854775808 and timestamps lacking exactly three fractional digits.
